notes.title: CubeHook VR - 1.4.1 Patch note
notes.content:
-Fixed bug when you get to a 5000 score the game will not give you a new cube
-Fixed bug when you will not lose when there are 2 cubes on the line

notes.title: CubeHook VR - 1.4.0 Patch note
notes.content:
CubeHook VR - 1.4.0 Patch note released
-Fixed achievement system.
-Improved main menu ui. design.
- Added new global Leaderboard.
-Changed map unlock score requirements.

notes.title: 1.3.2 Patch note
notes.content:
- Added new achievements, Now you will be able to unlock 6 new achievements in the game.
- Improvements to some of the maps.

notes.title: 1.3.1 Patch note
notes.content:
-Fixed bug when you shoot cube with the color brown it will change to orange, now it will stay brown.
-Fixed ScoreReset, now it will reset the score and lock maps.
- Improved first map.
-Changed unlock score requirements.
-Some optimizations to maps.
